bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2020. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2021 (for Q1, cumulative = discrete). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; extracted via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3), good quality. Extensively cross-validated: the 31-Dec-2020 comparative (total assets 11,260.02m, equity -11,659.25m) matches this dataset's own 2020_Q4.json exactly; the Mar-2020 comparative P&L column (investment income 174,311,158; net investment income 44,429,925; operating expenses 112,848,092; operating profit before provision -67,818,973; PBT -57,818,973; tax 1,109,462; PAT -58,928,435; EPS -0.09; NOCFPS -0.15) matches 2020_Q1.json's own figures exactly. This filing's own explanatory note independently states 'Net Operating Cash Flow per share- NOCFPS were 0.13 on 31 March 2021 but it were (0.15) on 31 March 2020', confirming both this quarter's NOCFPS and the 2020_Q1.json comparative. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C; provision D=-20.0m, a net recovery despite the source's own ambiguous '(charged)/released' label -- the recovery sign is required for C-D to equal the reported PBT; PBT-tax=PAT; PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.15, matching the source's own printed EPS exactly).
